title: REPORT with recommendations to the Commission on psychosocial risk, stress and mental health at work
part_text: F. whereas adverse social behaviour, including verbal abuse, threats, sexual and psychological harassment, bullying, violence and harassment, has a particularly severe and long-lasting impact on workers’ physical and mental health, while disproportionately affecting workers in health, public administration and client-facing occupations as well as female workers in general; whereas all types of violence, including third-party violence from clients, patients, care recipients or service users, should be explicitly recognised and proactively addressed through a gender sensitive approach;
